name: elysia-layered-architecture
description: Layered architecture convention for Elysia backend domains — controller/service/repository boundaries, contracts-first structure (including ports for external systems), module entry point index.ts exporting a <module>Module() Elysia factory that mounts every controller in route order, optional module-owned queues, route-ordering and macro-typing conventions, response-envelope placement, and boundary parsing rules.
author: OpenAgentic
